description: This is a C# source file (Program.cs) for an ASP.NET Core web API project that sets up a backend for data asset management. It includes configuration for services, middleware, API endpoints for health checks, asset management operations, and utility functions. The program uses minimal hosting model with top-level statements to define routes and middleware.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: Contains the input value for the validity check endpoint.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: Represents the validity check result, indicating if the value is valid and an optional reason.

classes.name: HealthRootResponse
classes.description: Represents the overall health check root response with status.

classes.name: HealthzDbStatus
classes.description: Contains database connection and health status information used in health responses.

classes.name: HealthzResponse
classes.description: Details of the health probe response, including overall status and database health info.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists, supporting syntax like export KEY=VALUE.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL used for OpenAPI documentation, respecting environment overrides, headers, and forwarded headers.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Forces OpenAPI document to use a server URL that matches the externally visible URL, for Swagger UI correctly calling the API.
